name: VoltAgent
description: TypeScript agent framework with a starter app that registers a working agent and a human-in-the-loop workflow.
whatItDoes: Developers generate a project containing a general-purpose agent with tools and memory plus an expense approval workflow that can suspend and resume. Supervisor and specialist agents can be combined into multi-agent systems.
howItWorks: The create CLI scaffolds the code, which wires an agent, optional LibSQL-backed memory and a Hono HTTP server. Models come from AI SDK providers, and the VoltOps console adds observability.

requirements.name: Node.js
requirements.description: Runs the CLI and generated project

requirements.name: LLM provider API key
requirements.description: For the AI provider used by the agent

models: Any provider supported by the AI SDK
